text: A brand is a collection of experiences that make up a persona in your mind. <break time="0.8s" /> And familiarity breeds liking. <break time="0.8s" /> Imagine you are set up on a blind date. <break time="0.8s" /> How critical are you. <break time="0.8s" /> Of that persons actions. <break time="0.8s" /> Everything they say and do is being evaluated and tallied. <break time="0.8s" /> An annoying slurp of the soup. <break time="0.8s" /> Could be enough. <break time="0.8s" /> To place this otherwise wonderful person. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the reject pile forever. <break time="0.8s" /> Now imagine. <break time="0.8s" /> You are married. <break time="0.8s" /> And your partner makes. <break time="0.8s" /> A similarly annoying soup slurp. <break time="0.8s" /> Is it time to file for divorce. <break time="0.8s" /> Probably not. <break time="0.8s" /> It is the same thing with brands. <break time="0.8s" /> When you first meet them. <break time="0.8s" /> You are on high alert. <break time="0.8s" /> Your defenses are high. <break time="0.8s" /> And you are ready. <break time="0.8s" /> For them to do something. <break time="0.8s" /> That will allow you. <break time="0.8s" /> To categorize them as a hero or a zero. <break time="0.8s" /> During this process. <break time="0.8s" /> Your brain is using. <break time="0.8s" /> A combination of subconscious and conscious techniques. <break time="0.8s" /> To evaluate the brand. <break time="0.8s" /> Once they have passed the evaluation phase. <break time="0.8s" /> And transitioned to a known. <break time="0.8s" /> Or even better, a favorite, brand. <break time="0.8s" /> They might slurp the soup. <break time="0.8s" /> From time to time and still be a ten.
